SCIM individual schema and resource-type discovery resolve declared identifiers
SCIM enterprise extension mapping survives create and independent read
SCIM filtering pagination and POST search return the actual persisted user set

SCIM group replace PATCH and search operate on the same stored resource

SCIM user and group deletion remove every created resource

A browser callback transaction cannot be redeemed twice
Refresh and userinfo preserve the authenticated subject
Refresh-token logout invalidates the server session
Pushed authorization request completes with the original PKCE state and nonce

UMA protection registers an actual resource and resolves it by id and name
UMA protection resource replacement persists

UMA permission-ticket grant returns an RPT and explicit runtime permissions

UMA ticket and policy revocation change a real runtime permit to deny

UMA protection deletion removes the registered resource

Default compatibility registration read update and registration-token lifecycle persist

SAML descriptor registration credentials authorize only its own client cleanup

Client Admin v2 rejects duplicates and does not confuse internal UUID with clientId
